Zbarazh New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Ternopilska oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This record shows a tension worth noting: it is categorized as 'fenced and protected,' yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'yes.' This is the newer of Zbarazh's two Jewish cemeteries, a companion to the Old cemetery documented elsewhere in this collection, serving a town that was one of the earliest centers of the Haskalah in Galicia and home to a Hasidic court founded by Yom Tov-Lipman Geller. Its earliest preserved gravestone dates to the early 20th century.
